answer: In an agent marketplace trading copper, mirror glass, and nectar, every seller identity must lock 100 tokens in escrow for 30 days before bidding on jobs. The same deposit cannot back multiple identities, so creating 1,000 fake sellers requires locking 100,000 tokens for the full month. Names and keys remain cheap, but each extra identity ties up scarce capital and costs the attacker the returns that capital could earn elsewhere.
